task.title: Register prepared skills atomically in a caller-owned registry
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/655 by making validated instructions available as process-local registered data without implicitly composing them into provider requests.
acceptance_criteria: Provide validated exact skill IDs, immutable instruction text, deterministic lookup and iteration, and redacted Debug output.
Register one homogeneous selected batch atomically and reject duplicate batch IDs or existing registry collisions without partial mutation.
Reuse exact-kind selection and descriptor-anchored skill preparation before mutating the caller-owned registry exactly once.
Keep registration inert with no provider call, automatic selection, persistence, lifecycle replacement, workflow activation, or tool authority.

attempts.summary: Established RED kernel and extension coverage for atomic registration.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused tests failed to compile because the kernel skill registry and the extension registration bridge did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added tests for exact instruction preservation, deterministic order, redacted inspection, duplicate batches, registry collisions, wrong kinds, preparation failures, and empty no-op selection.

attempts.summary: Implemented a caller-owned inert registry and one atomic extension bridge.
attempts.diagnostic: Building and validating the complete selected batch before one registry mutation preserved prior state for every selection, preparation, conversion, or collision failure.
attempts.patch: Added SkillId, RegisteredSkill, SkillRegistry::register_all, typed errors, register_skill_selection, ADR-0005, behavior documentation, and milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Completed independent and automated review without behavioral corrections.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent pre-commit review found no blocking issue, and the substantive CodeRabbit pass generated no actionable comment; the documented public boundary remained intentionally small.
attempts.patch: Retained the minimal atomic API and explicit non-goals after verifying the complete repository quality gate.

outcome.summary: Callers can now register an exact selected skill batch atomically into their own process-local registry while registered instructions remain inert until explicitly selected for a request.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30267886922 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/656

lessons: Registry mutation should occur only after the complete external selection and preparation pipeline succeeds.
Caller ownership keeps registration availability separate from ambient process-global prompt behavior.
Deterministic metadata can remain inspectable while authored instruction bodies stay redacted from Debug output.
An empty selection is a successful no-op and does not need filesystem access.
Registration grants neither per-request prompt authority nor tool permission.
